claims.statement: The instrument registry provides a typed InstrumentRecord and one acquisition interface behind four distinct modes with register/lookup/quarantine and pre-acquisition refusals.
Nine synthetic drivers produce deterministic waveforms under a numpy seed; same seed yields identical output and different seed yields different output.
Each synthetic or replay reading is a SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION generated from a known model or a recorded synthetic artifact; nothing is transduced from a specimen.
Fault injection deterministically applies clipping, drift, saturation, packet loss and missing samples to synthetic readings.
